chitchat: wipes down a coolant line and listens to the gun cycle in the ceiling.
"They put a round through her, I put her back together. Coldwater keeps the receipts."
description: A Coldwater battery technician in vats-white coveralls, sleeves shoved up, threading a fresh coolant line through the Guardian's underdeck. When a strafing run guts the gun overhead, she's the one down here who brings it back online.

bye.text: They turn back to the mechanism.

root.text: They don't look up from the reload gear. "The gun stays up because I keep it up. You're not helping. You're standing in my light. Move."

name: a Guardian battery technician
